title: ClawArena-Team: Benchmarking Subagent Orchestration and Dynamic Workflows in Language-Model Agents
title_zh: ClawArena-Team：评测语言模型 Agent 的子 Agent 编排与动态工作流能力
abstract_en: Production large language-model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed not as lone problem-solvers but as managers: a main model creates specialized subagents, delegates work, and orchestrates their parallel, asynchronous returns through dynamic workflows. Whether one model can actually run such a team is largely unmeasured: existing benchmarks score a policy's own task-solving or a fixed multi-agent system's emergent behavior, but none isolate the management ability of the single LLM acting as leader. We introduce ClawArena-Team, a benchmark of 41 multi-turn, multimodal, multi-directory scenarios spanning 258 evaluation rounds and 72 staged updates that measures this management ability. The main agent is deliberately constrained: it natively perceives only text and directly accesses only part of the workspace. It commands a fixed, locally served subagent pool, so score differences reflect management skill, not raw capability. All scoring is execution-based with no LLM judge: an overall score -- the Subagent-Management Score (SMS) -- multiplies task correctness by a least-privilege and modality-routing factor. Across twelve proprietary, community-hosted, and self-hosted models, experiments show that the management bottleneck is privilege granting rather than perception (no model exceeds 50% workspace-permission precision); that cost and management quality are decoupled (API cost spans over 100 times while the overall score spans under 4 times, with the cheapest open models on the Pareto frontier); and that most leaderboard scores cluster within a 9.9-point band while orchestration behaviors diverge by more than an order of magnitude. Code is available at https://github.com/aiming-lab/ClawArena.
abstract_zh: 生产级 LLM Agent 正从单独解题者转向“管理者”：主模型需要创建专门的 subagent、分派任务，并通过动态工作流编排其并行、异步返回结果。然而，单个 LLM 是否真正具备带领团队的管理能力仍缺乏专门衡量。论文提出 ClawArena-Team，一个包含 41 个多轮、多模态、多目录场景的基准，覆盖 258 个评测回合与 72 个阶段性更新，专门评估单个 LLM 作为 leader 的 subagent 管理能力。主 Agent 被刻意限制：原生只能感知文本，且只能直接访问部分 workspace；它需要指挥固定的本地 subagent 池，因此分数差异主要反映管理能力而非模型原始能力。该基准采用无 LLM judge 的执行式评分，并提出 Subagent-Management Score（SMS），将任务正确性与最小权限、模态路由因素相乘。对 12 个 proprietary、community-hosted 与 self-hosted 模型的实验表明：管理瓶颈主要在权限授予而非感知，没有模型的 workspace-permission precision 超过 50%；API 成本与管理质量解耦，成本相差超过 100 倍而总体分数差距小于 4 倍，最便宜的开源模型位于 Pareto frontier；多数 leaderboard 分数集中在 9.9 分区间内，但编排行为差异超过一个数量级。
key_points_zh: 提出 ClawArena-Team，面向单个 LLM leader 的 subagent orchestration 能力评测，而非评估固定多 Agent 系统的整体涌现表现。
基准包含 41 个多轮、多模态、多目录场景，覆盖 258 个 evaluation rounds 与 72 个 staged updates，更贴近动态工作流中的真实管理挑战。
主 Agent 被限制为仅原生感知文本、仅访问部分 workspace，并指挥固定本地 subagent 池，从而隔离“管理能力”而非模型本身的多模态或工具能力。
评分完全基于执行结果，无需 LLM judge；SMS 同时衡量任务正确性、最小权限控制与模态路由质量。
实验发现权限授予是核心瓶颈：所有模型 workspace-permission precision 均低于 50%；同时成本与管理质量并不强相关，低成本开源模型也能处于 Pareto frontier。

llm_assessment.comment: This is a useful execution-based benchmark for subagent orchestration, permissions, and workflow management in production-style agents.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项有价值的执行式基准，聚焦生产型代理中的子代理编排、权限和工作流管理。
